items.title: The sheafification of a presheaf of sets is a sheaf
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: 20 行、F# 是层：相容局部截段由 Pi(F) 层条件粘成逐点截段 s；对 s 验证性质 (*)：任取 u，落在某 U_i 内，由 s_i 的 (*) 得局部真截段 sigma，因 s 限制为 s_i，sigma 也代表 s 的茎，(*) 成立。承重两步（Pi(F) 粘合、(*) 验证）都在 span 内；1 处引用（连续函数层的类比）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-sheafification-sheaf (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1753-1756

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: given a covering U and compatible sections s_i of F# represented pointwise, use that Pi(F) is a sheaf to get a pointwise section s over U restricting to the s_i, then verify property (*) for s locally around each point using property (*) for the s_i (source lines 1758-1777)
